title: stack-diagram
question: How does the builder turn a draft into a portable diagram?
summary: A source-grounded map of asset embedding, validation, and the separate PNG renderer.

nodes.label: HTML draft
nodes.description: Reads the authored HTML draft as UTF-8. Its placeholders determine which assets need embedding.

nodes.label: Font assets
nodes.description: When --fonts is supplied, matching display and monospace placeholders are replaced with Base64 font bytes.

nodes.label: Icon assets
nodes.description: Supported images are inspected in sorted order. Only placeholders present in the draft are replaced.

nodes.label: Base64 encoder
nodes.description: The shared b64 helper reads asset bytes and returns their Base64 representation. Both font and icon embedding call it.

nodes.label: Token validation
nodes.description: Searches for unresolved %%...%% tokens after embedding. Missing assets stop the process before the write.

nodes.label: Build error
nodes.description: Exits with the unresolved token names. No new HTML is written on this branch.

nodes.label: Portable HTML
nodes.description: Writes the completed HTML after all matching tokens have been resolved.

nodes.label: Headless Chromium
nodes.description: The separate render_png script opens the HTML with Playwright and adjusts viewport width for the canvas.

nodes.label: Canvas capture
nodes.description: Captures either the full page or the selected diagram element. Missing selectors stop capture.

nodes.label: PNG output
nodes.description: By default captures light and dark versions. --single captures the authored appearance once.

sources.excerpt:
leftover = sorted(set(re.findall(r"%%[A-Za-z0-9_-]+%%", html)))
    if leftover:
        sys.exit(f"unresolved tokens: {', '.join(leftover)}\n"
                 f"(missing icon files in {icondir}? forgot --fonts?)")

with sync_playwright() as p:
        # headless Chromium hints glyph advances to whole pixels by default: uneven letter spacing
        b = p.chromium.launch(args=["--no-sandbox", "--font-render-hinting=none"])
        page = b.new_page(viewport={"width": 1200, "height": 1000}, device_scale_factor=scale)
        page.goto(src.as_uri())
        # .scroller clips a canvas wider than the viewport
        width = page.evaluate("document.querySelector('.canvas')?.offsetWidth ?? 0")
        if width + 100 > 1200:
            page.set_viewport_size({"width": width + 100, "height": 1000})
        page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # let embedded fonts settle

page.add_style_tag(content=SQUARE_CORNERS)
        if single:
            shoot(page, out)
        else:
            page.evaluate("document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme')")
            page.wait_for_timeout(120)
            shoot(page, out)
            page.evaluate("document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','dark')")
            page.wait_for_timeout(120)
            shoot(page, out.with_name(out.stem + "-dark" + out.suffix))

steps.title: Read the draft
steps.description: The draft contains the asset placeholders the builder needs to resolve.

steps.title: Embed only matching assets
steps.description: Fonts are optional. Both fonts and icons share the Base64 helper; these are code relationships, not parallel execution.

steps.title: Check every remaining token
steps.description: Missing assets are an explicit error exit before any output write.

steps.title: Write portable HTML
steps.description: The successful branch writes the self-contained document.

steps.title: Render a separate PNG
steps.description: A second command loads that document into Chromium and captures the chosen theme or both themes.
